authorities.releaseDiscovery: Compile-time GitHub API URL plus TLS-validated response.
authorities.channel: GitHub release latest endpoint with draft=false, prerelease=false and a valid vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tag.
authorities.versionName: Release tag is the remote version authority; candidate APK versionName must equal it.
authorities.versionCode: Installed PackageManager longVersionCode is the baseline; candidate APK must expose a strictly greater longVersionCode.
authorities.abiSelection: Runtime supportedAbis choose arm64-v8a first, then universal fallback; no arbitrary asset selection.
authorities.abiPayload: Native library inventory from the already SHA-256-verified APK bytes must intersect a supported device ABI. Asset filename or primaryCpuAbi alone is insufficient.
authorities.size: The unique trusted release asset size is authoritative; HTTP Content-Length/Content-Range only corroborate transfer and never override it.
authorities.integrity: The trusted release asset digest field in sha256:<64 hex> form is authoritative; transfer validators are resume hints only.
authorities.packageIdentity: Candidate and installed PackageManager packageName, longVersionCode, versionName and signer certificate digest sets.
authorities.installation: Only PackageManager readback of the installed application after system-installer return can confirm the exact target package.
authorities.installerStatus: System installer status is the only possible user-cancel authority; if status is unavailable after handoff, the result is INSTALL_UNKNOWN.

checks.authority: Compile-time repository constants and GitHub API HTTPS endpoint.
checks.rule: Use only the fixed Aurorama GitHub release endpoint; reject any configured/changed source.

failureVisible.copy: The update source could not be trusted.

checks.authority: HTTPS redirect allowlist derived from the fixed release URL.
checks.rule: The actual final download URL must be observed; initial github.com may redirect only to the allowed release-assets host, without credentials.

failureVisible.copy: The update download left the trusted source.

checks.authority: GitHub release draft/prerelease flags and stable channel policy.
checks.rule: Accept only draft=false and prerelease=false; no beta, nightly or arbitrary channel fallback.

failureVisible.copy: No stable update is available for this channel.

checks.authority: Strict vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH release tag and installed version.
checks.rule: Return UP_TO_DATE when remote is not newer; reject malformed tags and never offer a downgrade.

failureVisible.copy: You are already using this version or a newer one.

checks.authority: Trusted release asset list.
checks.rule: Exactly one expected APK asset name must match; zero or multiple matches fail closed.

failureVisible.copy: A unique compatible update package could not be selected.

checks.authority: Runtime supportedAbis plus documented asset-name mapping.
checks.rule: arm64-v8a devices choose the arm64 asset, fallback only to universal; other devices require universal. Empty/unknown ABI support fails closed.

failureVisible.copy: This update has no package compatible with this device.

checks.authority: Release tag, selected asset name and fixed GitHub release URL template.
checks.rule: browser_download_url must exactly equal the computed trusted URL.

failureVisible.copy: The selected update package is outside the trusted release.

checks.authority: Trusted release asset size.
checks.rule: Asset size must be present and greater than zero; unknown size cannot reach DOWNLOADED_UNVERIFIED.

failureVisible.copy: The update size could not be verified safely.

checks.authority: Trusted release asset digest.
checks.rule: Accept only sha256:<64 hex>; missing or malformed digest fails closed.

failureVisible.copy: The update integrity record is missing or invalid.

checks.authority: Trusted expected size plus HTTP 200/206/416 and Range/Content-Range.
checks.rule: A reported complete transfer must match expected bytes; inconsistent range evidence resets or fails without claiming verification.

failureVisible.copy: The downloaded update is incomplete or changed during download.

checks.authority: SHA-256 over the final local APK bytes.
checks.rule: Rehash the complete persisted file and compare with the trusted digest before parsing or install preparation.

failureVisible.copy: The update package failed integrity verification.

checks.authority: Android package archive metadata reader.
checks.rule: The hashed file must parse as an APK; parse failure cannot be treated as a benign install failure.

failureVisible.copy: The downloaded file is not a readable APK.

checks.authority: Installed and candidate PackageManager packageName.
checks.rule: Candidate packageName must exactly equal the installed application packageName.

failureVisible.copy: The downloaded package is not Aurorama.

checks.authority: Candidate and installed Android longVersionCode.
checks.rule: Candidate longVersionCode must be strictly greater than the installed baseline.

failureVisible.copy: This package is not a newer installable version.

checks.authority: Strict release tag and APK versionName.
checks.rule: Candidate versionName must exactly equal the selected release tag version and must not be lower than installed.

failureVisible.copy: The package version does not match the trusted release.

checks.authority: Candidate APK minSdk and current device SDK.
checks.rule: minSdk must be positive and no greater than device SDK.

failureVisible.copy: This update cannot run on this Android version.

checks.authority: Native library inventory inside the hash-verified APK.
checks.rule: The APK must contain at least one native ABI supported by the current device, or be a verified pure-Java APK. Unknown inventory fails closed.

failureVisible.copy: The update package contains no native code compatible with this device.

checks.authority: Installed and candidate APK signer certificate digest sets.
checks.rule: Both signer sets must be non-empty and exactly equal; signer rotation is unsupported unless separately proven, so mismatch fails closed.

failureVisible.copy: The update signature does not match the installed app.

checks.authority: Current user action in the app for this exact verified update.
checks.rule: Verification never launches an installer; INSTALL_AUTHORIZED requires a fresh explicit action and cannot survive process restart.

failureVisible.copy: Confirm the installation in the system installer.

checks.authority: Resolved Android activities and PackageManager permissions.
checks.rule: Exactly one system application granting INSTALL_PACKAGES must resolve; absent, multiple, untrusted or permission-denied handlers fail closed.

failureVisible.copy: A trusted system installer is unavailable or lacks install permission.

checks.authority: App FileProvider authority, validated updates directory and exact file name.
checks.rule: The handoff URI must target content://<applicationId>.updateinstall/validated_updates/<64hex>.apk and the canonical file inside the validated directory.

failureVisible.copy: The verified package could not be handed to the system installer safely.

checks.authority: System installer session/activity status.
checks.rule: CANCELLED requires explicit user-cancel status; FAILED requires explicit failure; missing status after handoff is INSTALL_UNKNOWN.

failureVisible.copy: The system did not provide enough evidence to confirm the installation.

checks.authority: Post-return PackageManager readback of the installed application.
checks.rule: Confirm only when packageName, longVersionCode, versionName and signer set all exactly match the verified target; installer launch or generic version increase is insufficient.

failureVisible.copy: The system did not provide enough evidence to confirm the installation.

prohibitedShortcuts: INSTALLER_HANDOFF to INSTALL_CONFIRMED without exact external readback
installer activity launch to installed success
generic versionCode increase to installed success

recovery.DOWNLOADING: Resume only when expected source identity, expected size, validators and Range evidence remain consistent; otherwise restart from zero or FAILED.
recovery.DOWNLOADED_UNVERIFIED: Always rerun size, SHA-256, package, version, ABI payload and signer checks after process restart.
recovery.VERIFIED: Reverify against current file and current installed baseline before any later handoff.
recovery.INSTALL_AUTHORIZED: Do not persist authorization across restart; return to VERIFIED and require fresh explicit action.
recovery.INSTALLER_HANDOFF: Query external package state. Exact target readback gives INSTALL_CONFIRMED; absent evidence gives INSTALL_UNKNOWN; explicit status may give CANCELLED or FAILED.
recovery.CANCELLED: User may restart download or install from a verified file; old asynchronous callbacks must be ignored.
recovery.FAILED: Keep existing app installation intact and expose retry, re-download or safe exit; stale/corrupt candidates are deleted.

capabilityBoundaries.requirement: Inspect native-library entries in the hash-verified APK; if the inventory cannot be established, FAIL_CLOSED.

capabilityBoundaries.capability: Installer cancellation reason from ACTION_VIEW return
capabilityBoundaries.requirement: Without explicit installer status, map unchanged/returned state to INSTALL_UNKNOWN, not INSTALL_CONFIRMED.
Exact installed signer-set equality is required; future rotation needs separate lineage evidence and decision.

capabilityBoundaries.capability: Final redirect URL in current transport abstraction
capabilityBoundaries.requirement: Observe and validate final response URL before reading bytes; if unavailable, do not mark the transfer trusted.
